reason: Project lens, not refuted. animate_mover (src/game.6502 2744) is plain main-RAM logic code: not PROTECTED (grind_config PROTECT covers only irq1_handler/not_vsync_2ed0/wait_for_vsync_2242), not generated, not data, not raster-timed, no self-modified operand, no entry past a label (only JSR animate_mover at 2966 and 3241; removed labels referenced nowhere). It reads the same RAM (movers tables at &13xx, zp &03/&84/&97/&7B, mover_types_animation_frame in HAZEL) with ROMSEL/ACCCON as before; it runs in the logic with X clear. The only behaviour change is the player-in-helicopter-out-of-fuel skip, now taken before the type load: exit X and C differ (old X=type, C=type>=&0D; new entry values) but both are dead: caller 2 (is_helicopter) does BNE on Z from LDA movers_y (same) then plot_player/plot_mover, which TAXes before reading X and writes C by CMP/CPY (check_if_mover_is_on_screen) before reading it; caller 1's move_mover_up/down start CLC/SEC and load X from mover_to_update. A, Y, N, Z, V on every exit are as before; the frame byte is stored identically (wrap stores flip = 0 OR flip). Recount from the listing: new layout &1FC9-&2001, am_wrap_e3fb at &1FF9 so BCS (&1FEE) stays in page &1F, no new page-crossing branch; savings non-player 2+1, player-not-in-heli 2+1, wrap -1 and no-wrap -1: 3 cycles an execution. Size grows 51 -> 57 (+6 bytes), which shifts everything from move_mover_right to the end of the main block by 6 (the EQUB pad is not shrunk): free space to unused_3400_original is 193 bytes (9 in SKY_HELI=0 builds), so it fits and the region ASSERT guards it. The one place the shift matters for paging: compiled_call (&2FEE, its RTS already at &3000) moves to &2FF4 so its compiled_back operand and the tail STA/STA/RTS land in &3000-&3006, per-screen RAM; this is safe because render_reset copies main &3000-&7FFF to shadow (code included), compiled_back is written (STX) and read (LDA #) inside the same call in the same ACCCON state (compiled kinds do not touch ACCCON), and compiled_vec (written by the renderer from elsewhere) stays below &3000 at &2FFD-&2FFE. The interrupt's code and variables stay below &3000 (keydown_int to &2F35, shown_screen ASSERTed). Gameplay builds' free space is checked by the assembly ASSERT in the gate.
